channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
item.description: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server. (4 sources: aws, javascriptweekly, nodeweekly, rprogramming)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
item.description: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
item.description: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform announces Azure-to-AWS cloud-native code conversion
item.description: Today, AWS announced the general availability of application code conversion from Azure SDK to AWS SDK in AWS Transform, giving you an accelerated path to migrate Microsoft Azure cloud-native .NET applications to AWS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now supported in the AWS Mexico (Central) Region
item.description: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks are now supported in the AWS Mexico (Central) Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Beam model by Reflection is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart and AWS Trainium
item.description: Beam, the first open weight model offered by US-based Reflection, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, the model hub in Amazon SageMaker AI. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Zod Brings In-Process Schema Compilation and a 9x Cut in Memory Footprint
item.description: Zod is a TypeScript-focused schema validation library that recently released versions 4.5 and 4.6. Key updates include schema compilation for faster data parsing, significant memory usage reductions, and new validation features. (1 source: infoq)
